meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据你的实际工作习惯，自动发现并生成新的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常执行重复研究任务，希望自动生成对应技能。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically discover your work patterns and generate new skills.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often perform repetitive research tasks and want to generate skills automatically.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会通过本地 screenpipe 读取你的屏幕历史，自动识别重复的研究工作流，与已有的技能库对比，然后为未覆盖的模式起草新技能或组合方案。
howto.when: 当你明确要求分析近期工作并提出新技能时，例如说出“分析我的最近工作”或“提议新技能”。需要 screenpipe 守护进程在本地运行。

say.text: 分析我过去一周的科研工作流，看看哪些步骤可以自动化。
say.note: Claude 会抓取屏幕记录，聚类重复模式，并输出提案。

say.text: 从最近的屏幕活动里找出重复模式，并起草新技能。
say.note: Claude 运行完整管线，生成报告和技能草案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads your screen history via local screenpipe, automatically detects repeated research workflows, compares them with existing skill library, and drafts new skills or composition recipes for uncovered patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask to analyze recent work and propose new skills, e.g., 'Analyze my recent work' or 'Propose skills'. Requires screenpipe daemon running locally.

say_en.text: Analyze my past week's research workflows and identify automation opportunities.
say_en.note: Claude fetches screen data, clusters patterns, and outputs proposals.

say_en.text: Find repeated patterns from recent screen activity and draft new skills.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full pipeline, generating a report and skill drafts.
